notes.title: Discolored 2 - Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
 
📢 Discolored 2 is out now!📢 

The game is also playable on the Steam Deck.
The soundtrack for the game is also available as a DLC with nearly an hour and a half of music! This includes a few bonus tracks that were made for the game, but didn't make the final cut. Even though they aren't in the final game they were too good to leave off the soundtrack. There's an extra discount if you get the bundle with the soundtrack.🎵

One last request, after you finish the game please consider leaving a review as the Steam algorithm favors games with a high review count, especially games that get reviews early after release. 😉

Thank you for your support these past four years! I hope you enjoy Discolored 2! ❤️‍💚💙

[previewyoutube=NY0xJnatqrM;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks! 
Jason

notes.title: Demo update - Ready for launch, some bug fixes, and language updates
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The demo was just updated with some bug fixes and updates to get ready for Discolored 2's launch. 

One important thing to note is this update breaks the save files for previous versions of the demo. This change had to be made in order to allow future save files of the demo to work with the full version of the game. Anyone who plays the demo now will be able to continue their progress in the full game once it is released. Leaving it the way is was, everyone would have to play the demo section all over again if they bought the full game after trying out the demo. Apologies if this causes any inconvenience. Fortunately, the demo doesn't take long to get through once you know where everything is. If you notice any issues please let me know.

This update to the demo also adds support for all the languages listed on the store page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110453/abf294c6af056d1b2b7e05cbe1b0d02f449b2f78.jpg

11 days and counting until launch! 
Wishing everyone all the best in the new year! 🎉🥂

Thanks!
Jason

notes.title: Demo update - some bug fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I just pushed an update to the demo with some bug fixes and reworking some logic in the menus to work better with a controller.

If you get this update and previously had the game installed you might have to reset the controls to prevent any weird behavior. Simply go to the Pause menu and then go to Settings->Controls->Restore Defaults and say yes you want to restore the controls to the default setting. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110453/abf40099672e3fe39b3b56d764bf40ab24bdcb86.jpg

From there, feel free to remap any of the controls as you see fit. :)

If you notice any issues please let me know.

Thanks!
Jason

notes.title: Demo update - quality of life improvements
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I just pushed an update to the demo with some quality of life improvements.

-Right-click will zoom out if you are zoomed into something.

-"R" will display a Hint instead of having to go into the Pause menu (though you can still do that too).

If you get this update and previously had the game installed you will have to reset the controls to prevent any weird behavior. Simply go to the Pause menu and then go to Settings->Controls->Restore Defaults and say yes you want to restore the controls to the default setting. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110453/abf40099672e3fe39b3b56d764bf40ab24bdcb86.jpg

From there, feel free to remap any of the controls as you see fit. :)

Other plugins got updates, but they are more "behind the scene" improvements.

If you notice any issues please let me know.

Thanks!
Jason

notes.title: Demo Update - multiple autosaves and bug fixes
notes.content:
The update for the demo today includes the option for multiple autosaves, bug fixes, and other QoL improvements around a couple of puzzles. If you run into any issues or have suggestions please let me know. 

Also due to the way the new autosave system works some of your old saves may get overwritten if you play through the demo again. However you can still manually save the game as before without the autosaves overwriting any new manual saves. 

You can switch back and forth between the autosaves and manual saves from the Load option in title screen and from the in-game Load menu.
